name: Detect Outsider
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 1, legendary inquisitor 1, paladin 1

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like detect demond, except it reveals the presence of a specific outsider subtype, creatures under the effects of spells or spell-like abilities cast by outsiders with the selected subtype, creatures otherwise tainted by them, or portals towards their plane.

You must select which outsider subtype you wish to detect at the moment of casting. An overwhelming aura from a creature with HD equal to at least twice your character level stuns you for 1 round and causes the spell to end.
